location_address: 2135 Pan American Plaza San Diego, CA US 92101
pricing: $65 per guest includes a guided walking tour.  Additional fees will be added when booking online.  Gratuity is not included.
description: Balboa Park is a unique urban park with rich history from the very beginnings of San Diego.  The park represents self-love, wonder, beauty and culture throughout every corner.  Styled in the Spanish Revival fashion of architecture of buildings that now house many museums, restaurants, and education program venues, and the gardens are lush and full of flowering plants and ponds.  The park is an escape from the day-to-day hustle of city life.  Enjoy a guided stroll around the park, and get a deeper appreciation for its beauty and history.
what_is_included:
🏙️ Walking History Tour – Explore historic buildings and landmarks of San Diego’s Balboa Park with a local expert

📚 Untold Tales – Learn the fascinating facts they don’t teach in school

🌇 Atmospheric Stroll Through Balboa Park's Hidden Gardens – Learn about the various plants that were brought to San Diego from all around the world
what_to_bring: Please wear comfortable walking shoes, and bring a bottle of water.
